name: queens_n4__v3_nh
prompt:
Place 4 queens on a 4×4 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 4 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 3) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.
